scope: exhaustive within every registered finite scenario domain; no sampling or time fallback
design: one factor at a time relative to the frozen primary; not the Cartesian product of all modeling assumptions
common_origins: all 65677 building features, with equal weights and a fixed full denominator
common_closure_domain: all 1684 primary source segments, all 1417086 distinct unordered pairs
parameter_grid: all W and K in baseline.json, both bus and bus_metro

segmentation_variant.domain: all 310 distinct source way IDs supporting the primary connections; all 47895 distinct unordered way pairs
segmentation_variant.failure: all dependent bus connections intersecting any part of the source way
segmentation_variant.length_control: record full physical source-unit lengths and exhaustive loss distributions within fixed length strata

context_policy: retain complete walking edges, entity connectors and riding connections only when covered by the buffered city mask; onboard passage through an inaccessible stop is retained if riding connections are covered
tie_scope: two fully evaluated deterministic tie policies; these are not bounds over every possible entrance assignment
route_reconstruction: derived order is an explicitly different sensitivity assumption, never an operational repair or a silent primary-model change
mechanisms: for all primary pairs: C = new_joint_only_losses - shared_single_losses, using exact origin-set algebra
path_cases: all tied maximum/minimum C signature pairs at W=1000,K=1 in both modes, and all negative-DeltaM single signatures at that setting; trace every affected origin, not a random origin sample
path_objective: minimum cumulative walking under the recorded boarding convention; report riding length descriptively without travel-time claims
